title: IWMT does not claim a definitive solution to the Hard problem

statements.text: Explaining every particular way that things feel is likely impossible, so IWMT does not claim to solve the Hard problem definitively, only to make inroads. The 2022 expansion is described as not quite solving it.

sources.quote: IWMT does not claim to definitively solve the Hard problem, as explaining all the particular ways that things feel across all relevant aspects of experience is likely an impossible task
